query: Before this muserver jar goes live, review every exposed listener and give us explicit TLS, body/header limits, overload, and graceful termination settings with live probes.
Clients can spoof X-Forwarded-For and poison redirects in our Mu Server behind nginx. Fix the trust boundary and test both the nginx path and direct access.
Rotate api.example.com's certificate in the running MuServer, verify SNI and ALPN on a fresh connection, and alert on expiry.
We see 431, 429 and 503 responses from io.muserver during traffic spikes. Make rejections observable and check our limits and executor capacity.
Write a Jakarta REST exception mapper for validation errors in our Mu Server API and return problem+json.
Generate OpenAPI YAML from our Mu Server JAX-RS annotations and host Swagger UI at /docs.
The HTTPS target behind our Murp ReverseProxyBuilder rejects its proxy client certificate; repair the upstream HttpClient SSLContext.
Create a generic Kubernetes Deployment with CPU and memory limits for this Java application; it does not use Mu Server.
